title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
abstract: arXiv:2611.19812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. translated_title: 循环中的推理：通过探询机制与测量实现抗体先导化合物优化
translated_abstract: “实验室在环”系统是一种流行的抗体先导化合物优化方法：模型提出分子，自动化检测测量其性质，再将结果反馈用于重新训练模型。这类系统针对由仪器信号计算出的指标所定义的规格进行优化，因此其成功取决于这些指标能否很好地代理候选药物所需的性质。当某个指标是糟糕的代理时，无论是更好的模型还是更多的数据都无法解决问题，而识别这类问题通常需要专家审查。我们报告了在 BigHat Biosciences 的 Milliner 平台上运行的两个项目，一个针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH），另一个针对抗间皮素单链可变片段，其中研究团队与通用人工智能代理 Claude 将科学推理引入了循环之中。在七轮迭代、约 1,010 个设计变体中，我们基于抗体谱系、结构和生物物理学构建了文库……
tldr: 该论文的核心创新在于将科学推理——由研究团队与通用AI代理Claude协作完成——引入“实验室在环”的抗体先导优化流程，通过审视机制与测量指标的代理有效性，在两个真实抗体优化项目中突破了单纯依赖更好的模型或更多数据的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is bringing scientific reasoning—through a research team collaborating with the general-purpose AI agent Claude—into lab-in-the-loop antibody lead optimization campaigns, probing mechanism and measurement quality across two real drug optimization projects to overcome the limits of better models or more data alone.
